Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — we’re moving toward a quick POC with a small subset of patient-facing features. Security has asked for a scoped subprocessor roster (CSV preferred) that includes: service name, purpose, data types processed, residency (country/region), and whether they hold encryption keys (Y/N). Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the checklist. We can supply a scoped CSV and short evidence bundle. Quick notes / clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:

- Dataflow mapping: we can provide a one-page diagram per subsystem; preferred format: PNG or PDF?
